questions.q: What is the article's main point?
options: Holiday travel is pricier in 2026, but flexibility and creativity can cut costs
Holiday travel demand has collapsed in 2026, forcing airlines to slash fares widely
Driving to holiday destinations is now far cheaper than flying for nearly everyone
Airfares have stabilized after the Iran war, but hotels have become costly
questions.explain: Prices are up but there are ways to save through persistence, flexibility and creativity.

questions.q: How did Melissa Cuomo's family of 15 save about $30,000?
questions.explain: A group rate for 10 or more got tickets just over $1,000 each.

questions.q: About how much was gas for a 400-mile New York to Pittsburgh round trip, per the article?
questions.explain: Gas for the trip would cost about $134 round trip.

questions.q: According to Points Path, when is the best time to book a Christmas trip?
questions.explain: The best time is about 56 days out, with a low-price window of 33 to 67 days.

questions.q: What does Expedia's quote "Demand is not disappearing; it is redistributing" suggest?
options: Travelers are shifting to less-obvious destinations
Airlines will add flights to small cities
questions.explain: Searches grew most for less-obvious places like Quebec City and San Pedro Sula.
